query: South Korea KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell value weekly latest June 2026, recent trend in trillion won
answer:
I've completed the research on KOSPI foreign investor net buy/sell flows. Here's the summary:

**KOSPI Foreign Investor Flows — Record 2026 Sell-Off (as of July 15, 2026)**

**Cumulative outflows:**
- H1 2026: foreign investors net sold ~**148.32 trillion won ($95B)** — a record first-half outflow
- YTD through July 3: ~**157.3 trillion won ($102.5B)**
- ~90% concentrated in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix; Samsung foreign ownership hit a 16-year low

**Most recent weekly/daily trend:**
- **July 13, 2026:** foreign net sell of **1.708 trillion won** as KOSPI crashed 8.95% to 6,806.93 (7th circuit breaker of the year)
- **July 8–9:** brief foreign net buying (+343.6bn, +134.8bn won) after 13 straight sell sessions (June 19–July 7)
- **June 30:** record single-day net sell of **7.76 trillion won**
- **Mid-June reversal:** ~2.0–2.2tn won bought June 12 (ending a 24-session, ~74tn won streak), plus June 15/16 buying that lifted the index to its all-time high of 9,114.55 (June 22)

**Context:** All this occurred despite the KOSPI's ~101% H1 surge — the selling reflects profit-taking/rebalancing and a weakening won. Retail investors (~105tn won bought) absorbed the outflows. Brokerages expect continued H2 selling; KB Securities estimated up to ~260tn won of additional potential selling.

Data is sourced from Korea Exchange (KRX) investor-type trading data. Note that Korean press typically reports running daily/cumulative totals rather than fixed Monday–Friday weekly buckets. Full structured findings with all data points and sources have been submitted.
